The monthly brief starts from what ran last month.

Always-on is not the same brief twelve times. Each month starts with what performed, what fatigued and what is coming up on your calendar, and the brief is written from that. On Growth that is two briefs a month; on Scale it is weekly.

↳Written from the debrief

On Growth and Scale, the month closes with a performance read. The next brief is written from it: which hooks to carry, which creators to bring back, which format to retire.

↳Your calendar, in the brief

Sales, drops, seasonal moments and the boring weeks in between all go in the plan, so the ads for a promotion are shot before the promotion.

↳Tracked live

Every brief sits on the live tracker. You can see the month's casting, scripting, shooting and editing move without asking.

A roster you have approved, cast brief by brief.

The first month builds a shortlist of creators who fit the brand. After that, casting is a matter of picking from people you already know, and adding new faces when the account needs them. On Scale, the roster is dedicated to you.

↳Approved once, cast often

Creators you have said yes to stay on your roster. Each brief casts from it first, so the tone stays consistent month to month.

↳New faces when fatigue says so

When a creator's ads start to tire, the brief adds someone new from the wider roster. You still approve them before they shoot.

↳Paid by us, once

Every creator is paid out of your package fee on a set schedule. One contract, one invoice, no separate deals.

Variants, cut per placement, so the account has a set.

One take becomes several ads: a different hook on the front, a different caption treatment, a shorter cut for Shorts, a longer one for Reels. The editor cuts for how each feed is watched, captions burned in and kept clear of the platform's own overlays.

↳Hook swaps

The same body with a different first three seconds is often the cheapest new ad. Each shoot captures more than one hook for exactly this.

↳Native, not resized

Every video is cut 9:16 for the placement it is going to, with the hook in the first frame and the caption inside the safe area.

↳One revision round, included

Every package includes one full revision round per video. It is usually spent on pacing or captions, not reshoots.

Whitelisting and Spark Ads, set up by us, running from the creator's handle.

The best-performing organic content runs as paid from the creator's own account, so the ad keeps the creator's credibility. hypjam handles the authorisation on TikTok and Meta and the usage rights that make it clean. Available on Growth and Scale.

↳Authorised, not improvised

Spark Ads codes and Meta partnership permissions are requested from the creator by us, as part of the brief, with the rights window agreed at the same time.

↳Rights that match the run

A whitelisted ad needs a licence that covers paid use from the creator's handle for the whole period it runs. That is written into the creator agreement before the shoot.

↳Disclosed properly

Paid partnership labels go on where the platform requires them, and the ad copy stays inside the CAP Code. We would rather lose a line than get you a letter.

Rights and safety

FAQ

Questions performance leads ask first.

↳Is there a minimum term?

Packages run month to month with a one-month minimum, so you are not locked into a long contract just to see if it works.

↳Who owns the ads?

You license them for the usage window in your package, for organic and paid use. We handle the paperwork with creators so the rights are actually clean, not just implied.

↳How does whitelisting work with the creators?

We request Spark Ads codes and Meta partnership permissions from the creator as part of the brief, and the licence for paid use from their handle is agreed before the shoot. It is included on Growth and Scale.

↳Do we get a performance read?

Growth and Scale include a monthly debrief that is written into the next brief. Starter includes the live tracker and our notes on what to run where.

↳Can we bring our own creators?

Yes. They are briefed, directed and paid through the same process as the roster, on the same contract.
